import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_4.csv"
]

# Columns of the target schema and their types
target_columns = [
    'Age Group',
    'Sex',
    "Don't know/Refused/Missing",
    'Normal Weight',
    'Obese',
    'Overweight',
    'Underweight'
]

# Mapping for 'Sex' column from source string values to target integer codes
sex_mapping = {
    'Female': 10,
    'Male': 11,
    'Refused': 12
}

# List to hold all loaded and transformed DataFrames
dfs = []

for file_path in source_files:
    # Read source CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    
    # Ensure all target columns exist in source (they do as per prompt)
    # Map 'Sex' from string to integer codes
    df['Sex'] = df['Sex'].map(sex_mapping)
    
    # After mapping, some 'Sex' values might be NaN if unexpected values appear; drop those rows
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Sex'])
    
    # Convert 'Sex' to integer type explicitly
    df['Sex'] = df['Sex'].astype(int)
    
    # For numeric columns, fill NaN with 0 and convert to int (as target examples show integers)
    numeric_cols = [
        "Don't know/Refused/Missing",
        'Normal Weight',
        'Obese',
        'Overweight',
        'Underweight'
    ]
    for col in numeric_cols:
        # Fill NaN with 0
        df[col] = df[col].fillna(0)
        # Convert to int
        df[col] = df[col].astype(int)
    
    # Select and reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    df = df[target_columns]
    
    dfs.append(df)

# Concatenate all source DataFrames (UNION operation) since all have the same schema after transformation
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the final DataFrame to the target CSV file path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSVs with index_col=0
paths = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_4.csv",
]

dfs = [pd.read_csv(p, index_col=0) for p in paths]

# UNION all source tables
df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Map 'Sex' string to integer as per target examples:
# From target examples: Female=10 or 11, Male=10 or 11, Refused=8
# Since target examples have Sex values 8,10,11, we assign:
# Female -> 10
# Male -> 11
# Refused -> 8
sex_map = {
    'Female': 10,
    'Male': 11,
    'Refused': 8
}
df['Sex'] = df['Sex'].map(sex_map)

# Group by 'Age Group' and 'Sex' and sum all other columns
group_by_cols = ['Age Group', 'Sex']
agg_cols = ["Don't know/Refused/Missing", 'Normal Weight', 'Obese', 'Overweight', 'Underweight']

df_agg = df.groupby(group_by_cols, as_index=False)[agg_cols].sum()

# Convert all columns to integer type as per target schema
for col in agg_cols + ['Sex']:
    df_agg[col] = df_agg[col].astype(int)

# Write output
df_agg.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
